title: Week.fromstring() rejects the extended ISO form 2011-W08
body:
In `isoweek.py`, `Week.fromstring` documents that it accepts both
"2011W08" and "2011-W08", but the extended form with a dash raises:

```python
>>> Week.fromstring("2011-W08")
ValueError: Week.tostring argument must be on the form <yyyy>W<ww>; got '2011-W08'
```

Expected: `Week.fromstring("2011-W08") == Week(2011, 8)`, the same as
the compact form. Malformed strings such as "2011-08" or "2011W8"
must still raise ValueError.
provenance: upstream code at a pinned commit with an injected regression; the oracle is the unmodified upstream file

source.modifications: reformatted with black (layout and quote style only) to pass the repository formatting check; snapshot adds the injected defect, visible tests and empty package markers

defect: The branch that parses the extended 'YYYY-Www' form was removed.
